meta.parties: Hollandia and Anglo-Swiss Condensed Milk Co. v. The Nestle and Anglo-Swiss Condensed Milk

rules.statement: The mere possibility of deception by passing-off is not a good ground for refusing registration of the mark.
rules.supporting_quote: "The remedy in such a case is an action for damages against the trader, and the mere possibility of deception by passing-oil is not a good ground for refusing registration of the mark."
